# metamcp_endpoint (Resource)

Manages a MetaMCP endpoint: the URL an MCP client connects to, publishing one namespace's servers behind an auth mode.

A namespace holds the servers; an endpoint exposes them. Create the namespace first and reference its `uuid` here.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `namespace_uuid` (String) UUID of the namespace this endpoint publishes.

### Optional

- `create_mcp_server` (Boolean) Create a MetaMCP server for this endpoint. Only meaningful at creation; the API ignores it on update.
- `description` (String)
- `enable_api_key_auth` (Boolean) Allow MCP API keys to authenticate. Defaults to `true`.
- `enable_oauth` (Boolean) Allow OAuth authentication. Defaults to `false`.
- `use_query_param_auth` (Boolean) Accept the credential as a query parameter instead of a header.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
- `url` (String) The MCP URL clients connect to, derived from the endpoint's name.
- `uuid` (String)
